Precondition: Config Tool open at the Operation Templates editor
Expected Result: Template is created with Code, Name, an OperationType role (DieCast, TrimIn/Out, MachiningIn/Out, AssemblyIn/Out), and optional description; starts in Draft

Step: Attach data collection fields and mark some required
Expected Result: Fields are attached via the OperationTemplateField junction (from the DataCollectionField vocabulary) each with an IsRequired flag; the template is reusable across products

Step: Create a new version of the template
Expected Result: New version is created following the Draft/Published/Deprecated lifecycle; the prior version is retained

Precondition: Two templates with different field sets (e.g. a Die Cast role vs an Assembly role)
Step: Open the production screen for a LOT resolving to each template
Expected Result: The production screen renders inputs from the template's OperationTemplateField rows — die/cavity/weight for the die-cast role, serial/material-verification for assembly; required fields enforced
Notes: rendering is shop-floor; config drives it

Precondition: Config Tool open at the Quality Specs editor
Expected Result: Spec is created with a name, an optional associated item, an optional associated operation template, and a list of measurable attributes

Step: Edit a spec's metadata (name, associations) and save
Expected Result: Changes persist and are audited; specs are engineering-managed via the configuration tool

Step: Revise the spec (create new version) and publish
Expected Result: A new version is created with a new effective date; the prior version is soft-deleted; inspection records FK to the version active at time of inspection

Precondition: A quality spec version being edited
Step: Define measurable attributes and reorder them
Expected Result: Each attribute carries name / data type / UOM / target value / lower limit / upper limit / required flag / sort order; reordering is via up/down arrows

Precondition: A published spec with defined attributes
Step: Open the inspection screen for a LOT governed by the spec
Expected Result: The inspection screen renders input fields dynamically from the spec's attribute definitions
Notes: rendering is shop-floor; config drives it
